sql:
SELECT
  t0.id AS tenant_id,
  t0.name AS merchant_name,
  t1.response_count,
  t2.avg_score,
  t3.median_score,
  t4.pct_satisfied,
  t5.pct_dissatisfied
FROM tenants t0
JOIN (
  SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS response_count
  FROM csat_responses
  WHERE submitted_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND submitted_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY tenant_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
) t1 ON t1.tenant_id = t0.id
JOIN (
  SELECT tenant_id, ROUND(AVG(score)::numeric, 2) AS avg_score
  FROM csat_responses
  WHERE submitted_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND submitted_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY tenant_id
) t2 ON t2.tenant_id = t0.id
JOIN (
  SELECT tenant_id, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY score)::numeric, 1) AS median_score
  FROM csat_responses
  WHERE submitted_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND submitted_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY tenant_id
) t3 ON t3.tenant_id = t0.id
JOIN (
  SELECT tenant_id,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_satisfied
  FROM csat_responses
  WHERE submitted_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND submitted_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY tenant_id
) t4 ON t4.tenant_id = t0.id
JOIN (
  SELECT tenant_id,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN score <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_dissatisfied
  FROM csat_responses
  WHERE submitted_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND submitted_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY tenant_id
) t5 ON t5.tenant_id = t0.id
ORDER BY t2.avg_score ASC, t0.name ASC
LIMIT 50
